Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1919. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1919, standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
